title: Discovering and choosing something together
meaning: An open introduction to a new endeavour can inspire you when attentive curiosity reveals the closeness of a freely shared choice.
text: A shared purpose does not always require a path known in advance. The Fool in the energy of Sahasrara supports openness to experience: you can enter a new endeavour without an established role and let understanding grow through acquaintance. The High Priestess in the physical position describes how you observe what is unfamiliar together, listening and noticing its inner substance. The Lovers in emotions bring the pleasure of free agreement. Discovering that something new matters to you both feels close, joining a willingness to try with attention to why you choose to participate among others.

Imagine attending an amateur science society for the first time. While others discuss observations, you listen and look through their notes without pretending to be experts. Gradually, you want to help describe an accessible route for beginners. **Something new becomes shared meaning when you both choose to take part.** The meeting of your interests feels rewarding. An unfamiliar evening now has a continuation useful to people who will one day arrive for the first time themselves.

The difficulty arises if attentive observation becomes a permanent position beside the endeavour. You attend meetings and understand much, but others do not know what you would like to undertake. Openness to the new and warm agreement remain supportive. Sometimes naming one simple role gives participation an outward form and turns acquaintance into an actual contribution.
